nom: ZealSea Face Mask Skincare Facial Sheet Mask Spa Gifts for Kids Girls Women

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily-normal skin says the light essence doesn't feel heavy or burdensome on her skin.
segments.sensitive: One reviewer with acne-prone, oily, sensitive skin reports no irritation and a hydrating effect, while another reviewer without sensitive skin says her face looked sunburnt and red after one of the masks and warns against use on sensitive skin.

concerns.aging: One reviewer notes that using just two masks of a single variety wasn't enough to judge whether it brightened her skin or reduced fine lines.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the masks as hydrating, leaving skin feeling soft, moisturized and refreshed, but a few say they didn't notice much moisturizing effect or improvement at all.
concerns.redness: One reviewer without sensitive skin reports her face looked sunburnt and red after using the Orange VC Brightening mask from the set and warns against use on sensitive skin.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily-normal skin says the light essence doesn't feel heavy or burdensome on her skin.

aspects.libelle: Cute, colorful, kid-friendly packaging and designs
Good value for the price, especially as a variety pack
Comfortable fit with some stretch to the material
Little to no scent on most masks, which some found disappointing
Labeled "Designed in Korea" but actually made in China
Packaging and folded masks can be fiddly to open

extraits.titre: ***Update***  I look like I was sunburnt!
extraits.texte: 🚨I wanted to update my review, the company reached out to me and offered me a refund even though it was way outside my return window! They did not ask me to update or take done my review. I have seen other companies do that. I bought these to do with my granddaughter back in December, this is the first opportunity I had to use them. I do not have sensitive skin and have used other mask before. The particular one I used in this set was the Orange VC Brightening Mask I am so glad it I decided to try one before letting her use it She’s a young and Im scared to see what it would have done to her!!! Unfortunately the window is closed for me to return them. If you have sensitive skin definitely don’t buy them, like I said I do not and I look burnt, my husband was like “what happened to your face”

extraits.titre: Cute Seal Design but Not Much Moisturization - Hard to Use
extraits.texte: The order of the ZealSea face mask comes in 14 packs. Each mask is packaged individually. There are two (2) masks of 7 different ingredients - aloe, orange, avocado, coffee, pomegranate, green tea. The product is "fun" with all the seal anmial design on the product varying by these different ingredients. Unfortunately, there is nothing special about these face mask other than the cute packing. The product is labeled as Korean Face Mask which if you know, Korea is known for their k-beauty products. I ordered the masks without questioning it but found the fine prints on the product that reads "Design in Korea" and "Made in China." The packaging is difficult to open. The folded masks enclosed in the packaging is even more difficult to open and unfold. There is not much moisturizing serum in the packaging. I also did not detect much of a scent either on the mask. I felt the product did not much moisturizing and was disappointed.

extraits.titre: Just ok but has great packaging
extraits.texte: What caught my attention was the catchy packaging. It’s so cute. Great for teens. I had to give it a try. But I was disappointed with the masks. They just felt OK. There wasn’t really anything memorable about it. I felt kind of good on but after removing my skin didn’t look improved or more moisturized. So if you have a teen spa party this will look great in a gift bag but for quality it’s just ok.

Very hydrating mask! These masks are really great for hydration. After every one of them, my skin feels fresh/moisturized/plump. There is a very slight tackiness left behind, but nothing too sticky. I didn’t experience any irritation at all. I have acne-prone oily sensitive skin for reference. I loved all of the masks in this set, except for the coffee one. It doesn’t smell like coffee, it smells like fake tanning lotion. I can’t stand that smell, and don’t like having it lingering on my skin. Other than that, it performed nicely. I just can’t fully relax with a scent I don’t like. But the others in the set are really nice. Cute names and art on the packets. The masks fit my face well and were comfortable to wear. They do have enough stretch in the material to kind of custom fit it to my face. Plenty of skincare included on each mask and in the packets. Overall, a nice set of sheet masks minus the fake tanner smelling one.

extraits.titre: Fun to try out and remember to wash off
extraits.texte: I was excited receiving these masks as they have so many varieties that I can try out. 7 kinds of with 2 of each. The essence is on the light side which doesn’t put too much burden on my oil-normal skin. While 2 masks of one kind is not sufficient to see any significant change, either brighten the skin or reduce fine lines, the varieties did help to encourage using them. On the down side, as other comments mentioned that they were designed in Korea but actually made in China; also, I will recommend to wash off afterwards instead of leaving in.

extraits.titre: Cute packaging and my skin feels great!
extraits.texte: My daughter is 10 and loved these masks! I felt the ingredients were safe for her skin. She had no irritation after use. The names of the masks are adorable and the packaging is so cute! I tried a mask too and they are sopping wet with face care! I left it on 15min to let it soak in. The mask fit her and I both great. My skin felt fantastic after!! The mask removed easily. I did think the price was a little high but she enjoyed it so much, I definitely want to splurge again. Plus, they work!!

extraits.titre: Fun to try but not a necessity
extraits.texte: These Zealsea natural sheet masks immediately caught my attention because they’re cute, colorful, and fun-looking. The packaging is adorable, especially with the little dolphin design, and each mask has its own unique look depending on the type, which makes them feel playful and appealing right out of the box. I tried the Avocado Moisturizing Mask. When I first opened it, I noticed there was no scent at all, which was a little disappointing. I wasn’t expecting it to smell like avocado, but I did expect at least a light essence or aroma. Instead, it’s completely neutral. The mask itself is a standard full-coverage sheet mask with cutouts for the eyes, nose, and mouth. It fit my face well and stayed in place easily. I followed the directions, cleansed my face, and left it on for 15 minutes. Unlike some masks, there was no tingling or sensation, so you don’t really “feel” it working — which could be a positive or negative depending on what you prefer. After removing the mask, I used an icy face roller to help massage the remaining product into my skin. That made a big difference. Once fully absorbed, my skin definitely felt moisturized and smooth. It didn’t leave my skin sticky as long as I worked the product in properly. If you don’t massage or roll it in, you may notice some dried product sitting on the skin, which isn’t my favorite, but it’s manageable. I do like that these masks are all natural, which makes them feel safe and gentle. I think this would be a fun product to us

reserve: Most reviewers bought these as novelty gifts or for children's spa parties rather than for skincare results, so detailed reports on skin type or specific concerns are limited.
